einzeiler: Bond selloffs, major Nvidia deals, and Apple's new CEO shape the markets.
kurzfassung: Global bond yields reached multi-year highs amid rising energy prices, inflation concerns, and a strong jobs report. Nvidia expanded its footprint through major deals in hardware, infrastructure, and software, including an acquisition of Hugging Face. Meanwhile, Apple saw leadership transition as John Ternes took over as CEO amid pressures to catch up in artificial intelligence.
stichpunkte: September started with a rocky market as Middle East conflict pushed Brent crude above $90 a barrel.
Global bond yields hit multi-year highs due to energy prices, government spending, and AI corporate bond issuance.
A hotter-than-expected jobs report on Friday pushed ten-year Treasury yields to 4.783%.
Interest rate futures priced a 60-40 probability of a September rate hike by the Fed.
Nvidia invested $3.5 billion in Taiwanese chipmaker Mediatek for AI hardware collaboration.
Anthropic signed a $35 billion cloud computing deal with Lambda, with Nvidia holding the data center lease.
Nvidia agreed to acquire AI startup Hugging Face for approximately $13 billion.
John Ternes officially became Apple's new CEO, replacing Tim Cook after a 15-year run.
Apple shares fell 2.5% on Friday as the new CEO faces challenges in catching up with AI competitors.

clips.hook: Growing odds of a September rate hike
clips.text: Ein robuster Arbeitsmarkt verstärkt die Markterwartungen an eine mögliche Zinserhöhung durch die Notenbank im laufenden Monat.
Der Chiphersteller investiert Milliardenbeträge in ein taiwanesisches Unternehmen, um gemeinsam an lokaler Datenverarbeitung und Fahrzeugtechnologien zu arbeiten.

beschreibung:
What caused bond yields to surge this week? And why is Nvidia expanding its presence in the AI boom? Plus, how did markets react to Apple's new CEO in his first week? Host Shradha Dinesh discusses the biggest stock moves of the week and the news that drove them.
